data.title: Grounding
data.tagline: Connecting claims to inspectable evidence and distinguishing support, inference and missing information.
data.description: An event assistant should match eligibility and deadline claims to the effective rules, not merely attach a related link.
data.learningOutcome: Check each important claim against the cited passage and version. State missing or conflicting evidence instead of inventing a complete answer.

explanation.title: In practice
explanation.text: An event assistant should match eligibility and deadline claims to the effective rules, not merely attach a related link.

explanation.title: What to check
explanation.text: Check each important claim against the cited passage and version. State missing or conflicting evidence instead of inventing a complete answer.

data.boundary: RAG supplies retrieved material; grounding concerns support for claims. A correctly formatted citation can still be irrelevant.
data.agentPrompt: Check every eligibility and deadline claim against effective source passages. Separate supported facts, inference and missing evidence. Identify conflicts without inventing a resolution.
